title: Relationship (edge)
description: One row per directed edge between two nodes (Document, ReferenceArchitecture, Entity or Source). No relationship may exist without evidence - this schema makes evidence/evidence_type/confidence mandatory. Rules enforced by scripts/validate_pilot.py (not expressible in JSON Schema alone): evidence_type=explicit requires confidence >= 0.7 and a literal, non-elided quote; evidence_type=inferred requires confidence <= 0.6 AND evidence text that references (by name or clear paraphrase) both the from-node and the to-node - a relationship whose evidence only describes one side must be removed, not marked inferred.

relationship_id.description: 'rel:<from_id>:<TYPE>:<to_id>:<source_file-hash>' - includes source_file so the same semantic edge asserted in two different documents produces two distinct, individually-sourced rows.

source_section.description: Markdown heading the evidence was found under. null is reserved for facts with no body-text location at all (front matter tags, folder membership). Any evidence taken from the document BODY that precedes the first level 2-4 heading must use the literal string '__introduction__' instead of null.

evidence.description: Verbatim quoted text that justifies this specific relationship. Mandatory, non-empty, and literal - MUST NOT contain an ellipsis ('...') or any other elision of the source text. If a single sentence is too long, quote the whole sentence rather than truncating it.
